prompt:

Keep his identity, face, costume, colours, proportions, line style and the exact sword design from Image 1, at the same size and camera distance as Image 1, three-quarter view facing screen-right like Image 1. Do NOT mirror him: the sword stays in the same hand as in Image 1 (both hands on the hilt only where the pose says so), and the sword is always ONE whole rigid blade.

Draw ONE single full-body sprite of him leaning far forward from the ankles, the rear leg loaded ready to dash toward screen-right, the sword kept low behind his hip, the free arm reaching forward. A clear, readable, powerful silhouette for a small phone screen; the body commits to the action (feet, hips and shoulders), not only the arm. Eyes open.

Background: 100% solid flat magenta #FF00FF, no gradient, no floor, no shadow. Centered, the whole character and the whole sword fully inside the image with a wide magenta margin on all four sides. Clean anime game sprite, crisp lines, same rendering as Image 1. No motion blur, slash trail, glow, wind, sparks, particles, speed lines, text or labels.

precheck.summary: Flat magenta background with no gradient or shadow, the character matches the reference outfit, colours and cape, the sword is one whole rigid blade in the same hand, and the figure sits fully inside the frame with no cut-off limbs, text or extra figures.
